OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The OpenCTI entity types the connector enriches.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

MISP_URL.description: Base URL of the MISP instance.

MISP_SSL_VERIFY.description: Verify the SSL certificate of the MISP instance.

MISP_IMPORT_ATTRIBUTE_TAGS_AS_LABELS.description: Apply the tags of the matched MISP attributes as labels on the enriched entity.

MISP_IMPORT_ASSOCIATED_EVENTS_TAGS_AS_LA.description: Apply the tags of the matched MISP events as labels on the enriched entity.

MISP_EVENT_FILTER_CREATOR_ORGS.description: Creator organisations (Event.Orgc, name or UUID) to include. If set, only events created by one of these organisations are considered.

MISP_EVENT_FILTER_CREATOR_ORGS_NOT.description: Creator organisations (Event.Orgc, name or UUID) to exclude.

MISP_EVENT_FILTER_OWNER_ORGS.description: Owner organisations (Event.Org, name or UUID) to include. If set, only events owned by one of these organisations are considered.

MISP_EVENT_FILTER_OWNER_ORGS_NOT.description: Owner organisations (Event.Org, name or UUID) to exclude.

MISP_EVENT_FILTER_NAME_REGEX.description: Regex searched in the event name (Event.info). Only events whose name matches are considered.

MISP_ATTRIBUTE_COMMENT_FILTER_REGEX.description: Regex searched in the attribute comment. The comment of a matched attribute is written in the Note only if it matches.

MISP_IMPORT_EVENTS.description: Create one OpenCTI Report per matched MISP event, containing the enriched entity.
